digest.component_or_area: model fallback orchestration and capability resolution
propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms for frontier and standard model classes are approved and have been live-proven capable of native structured output and thinking support, but remain unconfigured in rebar.toml

The whole-chain capability intersection mechanism in runner.py conservatively resolves capabilities before any fallback attempt, collapsing native structured output capability to PromptedOutput when primary and fallback have asymmetric capability rows

The exact direct Anthropic Sonnet model now has measured native-structured-output and thinking capability recorded via operator-attested live calls, resolving the standard-class capability asymmetry without requiring per-attempt orchestration redesign
Mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains must disable prompt caching because provider-specific cache styles differ and intersect conservatively to none
A valid non-interactive Anthropic credential exists but may be shadowed by an invalid one in process environment, creating a separate risk for enabling the fallback in non-interactive contexts
